mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong manufacturing output, a rising industrial production index signals sustained economic momentum that supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP growth signals expanding economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and the CPI index indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises discount rates and erodes equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index below 110 signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate production capacity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
